tools.name: calculate_nesting
tools.description: Lay out rectangular parts on rectangular sheets and return how many sheets are needed, the scrap percentage, the most usable offcut (a big, roughly square piece rather than a long strip), each part's position on each sheet, and a link that opens the job in MOACUT. Sizes in millimetres. Free limit: 1

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_nesting" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
